propositions: sync and s3_doctor both perform reconciliation of divergent heads but enforce contradictory policies on unrelated histories: sync refuses when local store already carries events to prevent grafting, while the doctor unions unconditionally
sync requires worktree-based git merge because consumers read ticket events directly from worktree files, while the doctor uses merge-tree/commit-tree and never touches the worktree
sync must never raise exceptions in its read path, while the doctor must raise S3DoctorConflict to signal the push path to abandon
Gerrit 1665 removed the doctor's worktree git merge implementation, eliminating the duplication this ticket originally targeted
only approximately four lines of graph arithmetic are sharable between the two reconcilers, insufficient value to justify cross-module dependency
